text:
meera: quick review of API Keys screen updates. Items: empty state copy, staged rotation UI, revoke guard for high-priv keys, and a11y checklist. Sharing Figma frames.

sam: empty state should push action. header idea: 'Create an API key to start calling Redwood'. CTA: 'Create API key'. Secondary: 'Key best practices' link.

jeremy: staged rotation is 🔑. UI: allow overlap window presets (1h, 24h, 7d) + custom. Show a colored badge for overlap length. Also show a small code snippet for swapping keys in SDKs.

kat: accessibility nits: - give modal role=alertdialog and focus trap - initial focus on first input (key name or scope) - copy-to-clipboard must announce via aria-live 'API key copied' - masked preview: include aria-label 'API key, ends with XXXX' and exclude masked chars from SR.

meera: revoke flow: require typing key name for 'Full' scope keys. For others, single confirm. Wording: 'Revoke key? This will immediately stop all apps using it.' Add link 'How to rotate safely' in modal.

sam: list page: add 'Expires' column with relative time; color-coded if <7d. Also scope chips with tooltips explaining permissions.

jeremy: microcopy for rotate modal: header 'Rotate API key' bullets: 'Create replacement key', 'Choose overlap window to keep both valid', 'Finalize to retire old key immediately'. Buttons: 'Create replacement' (primary), 'Cancel' (secondary).

meera: action items: meera update mocks (Tue), sam spec presets + list column (Wed), jeremy add SDK snippets, kat produce final a11y checklist. design-bot: follow-up scheduled Thu 11/02 09:30AM.

meera: thanks all  I'll upload frames and copy diffs here when ready.
